risks.title: Generic Competition
risks.score_rationale: Several generic manufacturers have filed ANDA applications for a generic version of JAKAFI with patent expiration dates in June 2028 and December 2028. The company is involved in patent litigation but has reached settlement agreements with certain manufacturers (Item 1 - Business)

risks.title: Drug Pricing Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Product revenues are affected by drug pricing initiatives led by governments and private payers. Changes to the Medicare Part D program since January 2025 have reduced rebate accruals (Item 7 - MD&A)

risks.title: Dependence on JAKAFI
risks.score_rationale: The company is substantially dependent on product revenues from JAKAFI. It must develop and commercialize new products to achieve revenue growth and offset loss of exclusivity (Item 7 - MD&A)

risks.title: Product Development Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The company devotes substantial resources to research and development, but successful product development in the biopharmaceutical industry is highly uncertain (Item 7 - MD&A)

risks.title: Economic Conditions and Patient Access
risks.score_rationale: Product revenues face challenges from economic conditions. Changes to patient assistance programs and usage estimates impact revenue recognition (Item 7 - MD&A)

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in Incyte's 10-K filing.
